n8b48cfb995.headline: IEA Warns Renewed U.S.-Iran Conflict Could Upend Oil Surplus Forecast
n8b48cfb995.summary: The International Energy Agency says renewed US-Iran hostilities threaten to derail expectations of a global oil market surplus. Crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz have recovered.
n8b48cfb995.why: The IEA is the energy agency that publishes the influential global oil supply and demand outlook, which shapes crude price expectations.
n8b48cfb995.why_moved: Renewed US-Iran hostilities threaten the expected oil surplus, even as crude flows through Hormuz have recovered.

n5e2aefb355.headline: US insists Iran commit to stopping shipping attacks
n5e2aefb355.summary: The US wants a public commitment from Iran that it will stop attacks on shipping in the Gulf. The demand comes amid the wider escalation between the two countries.
n5e2aefb355.why: The Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz handle a large share of global seaborne oil trade. Attacks on shipping raise freight costs and insurance premiums and can disrupt supply.

n5b91fcaa98.headline: Fincantieri Partners with Croatian Shipyards for MRC Corvettes Program
n5b91fcaa98.summary: Italian shipbuilder Fincantieri has signed two memoranda of understanding with Croatian shipbuilding companies for its MRC corvettes programme. Further details were not included in the input.
n5b91fcaa98.why: Fincantieri is one of Europe's largest shipbuilders, building naval and cruise vessels. Partnerships with regional yards can spread production and share work on defence contracts.

nac7c6a92cd.headline: Iran and U.S. ramp up tit-for-tat strikes as Khamenei laid to rest
nac7c6a92cd.summary: Former Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was buried amid an escalating exchange of fire between Iran and the US, on the 132nd day of the war. The article gives no further detail.
nac7c6a92cd.why: Escalation between Iran and the US affects oil supply risk, shipping routes and broader risk sentiment in global markets.

na79e19c892.headline: US demands Iran publicly state that Strait of Hormuz is open and Tehran won't attack ships anymore
na79e19c892.summary: US officials said Washington is demanding that Iran publicly state the Strait of Hormuz is open and that it will not attack ships crossing the corridor. The demand was reported on Friday.
na79e19c892.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so any threat to shipping there affects crude prices, tanker rates and insurance costs.

ndd973b3c05.headline: Stock Index Futures Slip as Chip Rally Fades, SK Hynix Debut in Focus
ndd973b3c05.summary: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were lower after a chip-led rally, with investors watching the US trading debut of SK Hynix. The index futures were down about 0.11% and 0.41%.
ndd973b3c05.why: SK Hynix is a leading memory chipmaker supplying AI servers, so its listing and the chip sector's direction influence semiconductor valuations and broader US index moves.

n475542cd4e.summary: Chevron has agreed to supply 46 petajoules of natural gas to Alinta Energy from July 2027 under a five-year deal. The agreement is intended to reinforce domestic gas supply in Western Australia.
n475542cd4e.why: Chevron is a large US energy company with major Australian gas operations, and long-term supply contracts underpin revenue visibility for gas producers.

n3d28856f16.headline: GoTyme Bank reports 10 million users after 3 years
n3d28856f16.summary: GoTyme Bank said it reached 10 million users and more than P53 billion in customer deposits, just over three years after launching in the Philippines.
n3d28856f16.why: GoTyme is a digital bank in the Philippines, and deposit growth reflects the expansion of digital retail banking.

n69708492a8.headline: Fullerton Health co-founders fined for submitting and approving false and inflated expense claims
n69708492a8.summary: Fullerton Health co-founders Daniel Chan Pai Sheng and Michael Tan Kim Song, former deputy group CEO and group CEO, received a discharge not amounting to an acquittal on corruption charges.
n69708492a8.why: Fullerton Health is a Singapore-based healthcare group, and governance failures at the top can affect investor and regulatory confidence.

n565bdb911f.headline: Wall Street Climbs Oil Slides as Investors Bet on AI Growth Over Middle East Tensions
n565bdb911f.summary: All three major U.S. indexes closed the week higher, with SK Hynix shares surging in their U.S. market debut. Oil prices fell amid renewed Middle East hostilities.
n565bdb911f.why: The S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq are the main U.S. equity benchmarks that institutional investors track for market direction.
n565bdb911f.why_moved: Investors favored AI-related growth while oil prices fell amid Middle East tensions.

n81dc816e99.headline: E20 may cut mileage by up to 5 pc but offers cleaner combustion: Oil Min
n81dc816e99.summary: India's Oil Ministry said petrol blended with 20% ethanol can reduce fuel economy by 3-5% in some vehicles. It argued benefits such as higher octane outweigh the impact.
n81dc816e99.why: Ethanol blending policy affects fuel demand, agricultural markets and automaker and refiner planning in India.

n02bea1d9d1.headline: Weak Monsoon May Hit Rural Demand, Farm Income And Microfinance Sector: S&P Report
n02bea1d9d1.summary: S&P Global Ratings warned a weak southwest monsoon could cut farm incomes, raise inflation and slow rural demand, with agriculture, tractors, two-wheelers and microfinance most exposed.
n02bea1d9d1.why: Rural demand drives a large share of India's consumption, so monsoon rainfall is a key macro variable for Indian corporates and lenders.

n5cd1453ab7.headline: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rise to cap choppy week as SK Hynix pops in US debut
n5cd1453ab7.summary: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose to cap a choppy week. Investors watched the marquee US listing of SK Hynix, whose shares popped on their debut.
n5cd1453ab7.why: The S&P 500 is the main US large-cap benchmark, and the Nasdaq tracks major technology companies, including semiconductor makers.

nf7cb1106f8.summary: Shares of South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix rose nearly 13% in their Wall Street debut. Demand for memory chips is surging amid the AI boom.
nf7cb1106f8.why: SK Hynix is one of the world's largest memory chip makers, supplying high-bandwidth memory used in AI accelerators.

ndbc261b8d0.headline: China and Japan Have a Confrontation Near Disputed Senkaku Islands Amid Rising Tensions in First Island Chain
ndbc261b8d0.summary: A confrontation between China and Japan near the disputed Senkaku Islands is reported amid rising tensions in the first island chain. China, Japan and Taiwan all claim sovereignty over the islands.
ndbc261b8d0.why: Tensions over the Senkakus involve a key shipping and security corridor in East Asia, which can affect regional risk premia and trade.

nfd94d6dfde.headline: Govt to Launch New Policy for EVs, Hybrid Cars Next Month
nfd94d6dfde.summary: Pakistan's federal government is expected to unveil its new Auto Policy in August, with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif directing officials to prepare it. The policy covers electric vehicles and hybrid cars.
nfd94d6dfde.why: Auto policy sets tax and incentive rules for car makers and buyers, shaping investment in vehicle manufacturing and EV supply chains.

n6b152bc43c.headline: ADNOC Orders $900 Million in New LNG Carriers to Expand Global Fleet
n6b152bc43c.summary: ADNOC Logistics and Services has ordered four additional LNG carriers, valued at $900 million, to expand export capacity. The move supports ADNOC's long-term LNG growth ambitions.
n6b152bc43c.why: ADNOC Logistics & Services is the shipping arm of Abu Dhabi's ADNOC group, and LNG fleet expansion supports gas export capacity.

n4a1440e101.headline: Teodoro: Countering China aggression requires defense budget of up to 4% of GDP
n4a1440e101.summary: Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said countering Chinese aggression and protecting maritime rights could require raising the defence budget to as much as 4% of GDP, forcing trade-offs elsewhere.
n4a1440e101.why: Defence spending shifts affect government budgets and fiscal priorities, which matter for investors assessing the Philippines' fiscal position and regional security risk.

n0411c9b65f.headline: SoftBank Eyes Seven & i Stake
n0411c9b65f.summary: SoftBank is in talks about a stake in Seven & i Holdings, the owner of 7-Eleven, which could bring new capital into the company.
n0411c9b65f.why: Seven & i is a major Japanese retail group, and SoftBank is a large Japanese technology investor.

nc9be374bee.headline: A Potential New Rival Wants to Undercut TSMC. Here's What Investors Need to Know.
nc9be374bee.summary: Japanese chipmaker Rapidus hopes to mass-produce 2-nanometre chips in 2027, positioning it as a potential new rival to TSMC.
nc9be374bee.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, and new advanced-node competitors affect the global semiconductor supply chain.

n997dae8f2d.headline: Vietnam eyes greater Canadian investment as FTA talks progress
n997dae8f2d.summary: Vietnam and Canada aim to deepen finance, investment and green economy ties, with hopes of finalising an ASEAN-Canada trade deal this year.
n997dae8f2d.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and shape investment flows between Asian and North American economies.

n8b208bede3.headline: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in the biggest foreign IPO in US history, is urged to build new US fabs
n8b208bede3.summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5 billion in what is described as the biggest foreign IPO in US history. SK Hynix and Samsung are being asked to build US factories.
n8b208bede3.why: SK Hynix is a major South Korean maker of memory chips used in AI servers. Its share sales and capacity decisions affect the global semiconductor supply chain.

n8b22c37801.headline: Japan’s Wholesale Inflation Hits 3-Year High
n8b22c37801.summary: Japan's producer prices rose 7.1% in June as fuel and metals costs surged. The data heightened expectations of another interest rate hike this year.
n8b22c37801.why: Producer price inflation feeds into consumer prices and influences the Bank of Japan's policy path, which affects yen and Japanese government bond yields.
